title: Add date selection and totalizer tracking for sales and shifts

requirements.summary: Add a date picker field to the new sale form to allow entering or selecting a custom date for backdated sales entries
acceptanceCriteria: Date picker component is added to the SalesForm component
Selected date is captured and stored with each sale record
Date defaults to current date/time if not explicitly changed

file_operations.description: Add a date-time picker input field using shadcn/ui components (Popover + Calendar + Input for time). Store the selected date in component state and pass it to the recordSale backend function as the saleDate parameter (convert to bigint nanoseconds). Default the picker to the current date/time. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add open totalizer and end totalizer numeric input fields to the new sale form
acceptanceCriteria: Two numeric input fields added to SalesForm: 'Open Totalizer' and 'End Totalizer'
Fields accept decimal values representing totalizer readings
Both fields are clearly labeled in the form

file_operations.description: Add two numeric input fields labeled 'Open Totalizer' and 'End Totalizer' using shadcn/ui Input components with type='number' and step='0.01'. Store values in component state (openTotalizer and endTotalizer). Pass these values to the recordSale backend function. Ensure fields are clearly labeled and positioned logically in the form layout.

requirements.summary: Automatically calculate and display the volume of petrol or diesel dispensed based on the difference between end totalizer and open totalizer readings
acceptanceCriteria: Calculated volume is displayed in real-time as (End Totalizer - Open Totalizer)
Calculation updates automatically when either totalizer value changes
Volume is displayed with appropriate units (liters)
Validation ensures end totalizer is greater than or equal to open totalizer

file_operations.description: Add a calculated volume display that shows (endTotalizer - openTotalizer) in real-time. Use useEffect or derived state to recalculate when either totalizer value changes. Display the result with 'liters' unit label. Add validation to show an error message if endTotalizer < openTotalizer. Disable form submission when validation fails. Position the calculated volume display prominently near the totalizer fields.

requirements.summary: Add start shift date and time picker fields to the Start New Shift dialog
acceptanceCriteria: Date and time picker component is added to the shift start dialog in ShiftManagement component
Selected date/time is captured when starting a new shift
Date/time defaults to current date/time if not explicitly changed

file_operations.description: Add a date-time picker input field to the Start New Shift dialog using shadcn/ui components (Popover + Calendar + Input for time). Store the selected date in component state and pass it to the startShift backend function as the shiftDate parameter (convert to bigint nanoseconds). Default the picker to the current date/time. Position the date-time picker prominently in the shift start dialog above the staff selection dropdown. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
